subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, while treating Telegram DM default isolation as a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: Source inspection shows a concrete `heartbeat.session` precedence bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from the documented main-session default can affect existing users who rely on shared main-session continuity.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix system-event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while preserving the existing Telegram DM default until a separate compatibility decision is made.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting the upgrade, docs, and regression-test impact for users relying on shared main-session context.

options.title: Defer to per-session heartbeat design
options.body: Hold the concrete bug behind the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling direction, which may be cleaner but leaves the forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix system-event-triggered heartbeat routing so explicit `heartbeat.session` wins, while preserving the existing Telegram DM default until a separate compatibility decision is made.

likelyOwner.reason: The heartbeat session feature and follow-up history make this the strongest available routing owner for the maintainer decision.
